verdict.rationale: Clara documents a Card Configurations API for merchant-category, time, and day-of-week restrictions, plus card spending limits that reset on a set schedule. Cards can also be locked and unlocked manually. However, the evidence never states that out-of-policy spend is declined or auto-locked at the point of sale, and it covers only merchant categories, not individual merchants. Missing for 10: explicit point-of-sale decline or auto-lock behavior, restriction by individual merchant, a documented per-transaction amount cap, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can restrict cards by category, merchant, and amount — and the platform auto-locks or declines out-of-policy spend at the point of sale

citations.quote: Use the Card Configurations API to add time, day-of-week, or merchant category restrictions. All fields are optional and can be combined.
